title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00012:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 12 (Fees for Supervision Services)
(1) The Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants may collect a fee for supervision services, which shall be no more than 1% of the audit fees received by the auditor in the relevant fiscal year, in accordance with Article 38(2) of the Act.
(2) In addition, the detailed matters required for collecting fees for supervision services shall be determined by the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants.
